name: wardfy
description: A social music platform that connects Spotify communities to Discord.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web,bot -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:bot"
scripts.dev:api: npm run infra:up && npm run db:prepare && npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@wardfy/api
scripts.dev:bot: npm run api:wait && npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@wardfy/bot
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/shared && npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/api && npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/bot && npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@wardfy/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@wardfy/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@wardfy/bot && npm run typecheck --workspace=@wardfy/web
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy
